Name: Mana Missile
Description: Fires a small pellet of magical force. Although the damage is trivial, the pellet never misses.

Name: Ice Shield
Effect: Temporarily equips a shield that has 14 health. Every time the enemy misses, the shield takes the enemy’s damage roll in damage. When the shield HP drops to 0, the spell expires.
Description: Condense ambient air and water into a temporary shield.

Name: Slip
Description: Casts a small field of ice over the floor, causing the enemy to slip and lose a turn.

Name: Mana Ray
Description: Fires a beam of condensed magical energy.

Name: Fireball
Effect: On hit, apply 1d4 burn damage to enemy per round for 3 rounds.
Description: Lobs a ball of magical fire that will envelope an enemy, roasting them.

Name: Glacial Shard
Effect: On hit, enemy loses its next turn.
Description: Launches a spear of ice so cold it temporarily freezes the enemy.

Name: Flyer Fins
Effect: Player moves two tiles at a time.
Description: Wings of energy extend from your feet, allowing you to move swiftly.

Name: Magic Barrier
Description: Erects a sphere of magical energy to protect the user.

Name: Revengeance Barrier
Effect: Adds (INT) to DV and MDV and enemy takes (spellDamage) if it manages to hit the player
Description: A modified Magic Barrier that also retaliates against the attacker.

Name: Blink
Effect: Moves player to target tile within view, cannot move through wall.
Description: A novice teleportation spell that allows the player to instantly transmit themselves a short distance.

Name: Wind Shield
Effect: Negates an attack against the player’s DV
Description: Summon magical winds that block physical strikes.

Name: Water Shield
Effect: Negates an attack against the player’s MDV
Description: Summon magical water to inhibit the strikes of magical opponents.

Name: Lesser Heal
Description: Magical energy heals the user by a small amount.

Name: Heal
Description: Magical energy heals the user by a moderate amount.

Name: Greater Heal
Description: Magical energy heals the user by a substantial amount.

Name: Lightning Bolt
Description: The user casts a great bolt of magical lighting at the opponent.

Name: Shadow Globe
Description: The user is shrouded in a globe of oozing shadow, concealing them from enemies.

Name: Haste
Description: The user accelerates themselves, allowing them to attack twice in a turn.

Name: Imbibe Luck
Effect: Guarantees an item drop when the player defeats an enemy.
Description: Absorb ambient luck particles from the time stream to force fate.

Name: Blood Wrench
Effect: On hit, absorb (spellDamage) HP from the enemy and give to the player.
Description: Draw out the enemy’s blood and absorb it into your own life force.
